'Queen's House' () is an ongoing South Korean television series starring Hahm Eun-jung, Seo Jun-young, Park Yoon-jae, and Lee Ga-ryeong. It premiered on KBS2 on April 28, 2025, and airs every Monday to Friday at 19:50 (KST).
Synopsis
Kang Jae In is the youngest leader for a design team at YL Group and she comes from a wealthy family. She is married to Hwang Gi Chan, who works as a director at YL Group. Her life seems so ideal that she is the envy of many people. Nevertheless, Kang Jae In dreams of an ordinary and simple life, unlike her ambitious husband Hwang Gi Chan. An incident leads to Kang Jae In's life changing completely. Meanwhile, Kim Do Yun is an excellent thoracic surgeon. He is warm-hearted and easygoing, but he loses someone precious to him all of a sudden. He vows to take revenge.
Cast
Main
* Ham Eun-jung as Kang Jae-in
: The youngest design team leader at YL Group. Jane was born into a family envied by everyone, but she dreams of living a normal and simple life. Jane, who met her beloved husband through an acquaintance, builds the family she desired and lives happily. But she soon loses everything after being exposed to life-changing events by the people closest to her.
* Seo Jun-young as Kim Do-yoon
: A thoracic surgeon who is the pride of Korea University Hospital, Do-yeon, with his warm and friendly personality, has the charm to put others at ease. However, Do-yeon, who loses a loved one overnight in a horrific accident, vows revenge.
* Park Yoon-jae as Hwang Ki-chan
: Jay-in's husband and director of YL Group's strategic planning team.
* Lee Ga-ryeong as Kang Se-ri
: Lee Jae In's best friend and a designer on the planning and design team at YL Group.
Supporting
* Namgyeong-eup as  Kang Gyu-cheol (Ep1~16)
* Lee Sang-sook as Choi Ja-young
* Kim Si-woo as  Hwang Eun-ho
* Lee Bo-hee as No Seok-ja
* Park Chan-hwan as Do Min-joon
* Kang Kyung-heon as Kang Mi-ran
* Kim Ae-ran as Jeong Yoon-hee
* Kim Hyun-gyun as Jeong Oh-seong
* Kang Sung-min as Hwang Ki-man
* Cha Min-ji as Do Yu-kyung
Production
The series is written by Kim Min-ji, who wrote Sunny Again Tomorrow (2018) and Gold Mask (2022), and co-directed by  and Hong Eun-mi. It is produced by Flying Entertainment and Ascendio.
